Expanded trial production, quality review, and initial Lead Clipper assignment
Revised qualification clips, iterative corrections, and hiring approval
Monthly production onboarding and Instagram account setup

requirements.title: Clipper Qualification Process
requirements.definition: The task-local screening or clip-production process the freelancer must complete to qualify for the ongoing role.
requirements.boundary_note: Includes changes among a three-clip trial, screening form, 15-to-20-clip trial, and later reference-matching qualification tasks; concrete clip-quality standards remain separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Monthly Approved Clip Quota
requirements.definition: The recurring required volume and cadence of clips that must receive approval during each monthly production period.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the 125-to-100 approved-clips-per-month target and associated daily cadence; approval criteria, publishing, and compensation are separate mechanisms.

requirements.title: Clip Approval Gate
requirements.definition: A clip must be reviewed and approved by the client before it counts toward production obligations or is authorized for publication.
requirements.boundary_note: Represents the independent review gate and its consequences; the visual and content rules used during review are owned by separate creation-standard Requirements.

requirements.title: Clip Submission Workflow
requirements.definition: Clips must be delivered through the client-specified review channel and folder or workspace structure.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers transport and organization of submissions, including chat samples, Google Drive folders, and the planned Notion workflow; it excludes clip content and publishing rules.

requirements.title: Clip Source Selection
requirements.definition: Clips must be derived from permitted Teyron long-form YouTube source material under the currently specified source-selection constraints.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers which long-form videos may supply footage; selection of a complete lesson, hook quality, and editing treatment are independently testable Requirements.

requirements.title: Complete Standalone Teaching Moment
requirements.definition: Each clip must present a complete lesson, story, or point from start to finish and remain understandable as a standalone piece.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns semantic completeness and standalone value; duration, hook choice, captions, effects, and B-roll can each change or fail independently.

requirements.title: Clip Duration
requirements.definition: Each clip must remain within the client-confirmed duration range and minimum-length approval threshold.
requirements.boundary_note: Duration is independently measurable and repeatedly changed from 30–90 seconds to a stricter 45–60-second target with an under-45 rejection rule.

requirements.title: Clean and Simple Editing Style
requirements.definition: Clips must use clean professional editing without heavy animations, flashy transitions, or distracting visual effects.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers non-caption visual effects and transitions; caption formatting, B-roll use, and audio treatment have distinct acceptance criteria.

requirements.title: Caption Visual Style
requirements.definition: On-screen captions must follow the current rules for color, font, effects, outline or shadow, and stable placement.
requirements.boundary_note: Color, font, shadow, and placement are treated as attributes of one caption-rendering mechanism rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Natural B-Roll Integration
requirements.definition: Provided B-roll must be incorporated where it naturally supports and strengthens the clip's spoken message.
requirements.boundary_note: B-roll use is independently assessable and was introduced for live production; it does not own source-video selection or general effects policy.

requirements.title: Background Music Mix
requirements.definition: Background music must fit the clip's mood and remain below Teyron's voice in the audio mix.
requirements.boundary_note: Music selection and level can be changed independently of ambient-noise cleanup and visual editing.

requirements.title: Audio Noise Cleanup
requirements.definition: Distracting source noise, including wind noise, must be removed or reduced so the spoken content remains clean.
requirements.boundary_note: Ambient-noise correction has its own observed failure and claimed fix and is therefore separate from background-music mixing.

requirements.title: Hook Selection and Variations
requirements.definition: Clips must open with strong hooks, with later production allowing controlled variations that reuse a body clip with different openings.
requirements.boundary_note: Hook quality and opening variation can be targeted without changing the complete lesson in the clip body, so they remain separate from moment completeness.

requirements.title: Dedicated Instagram Account Setup
requirements.definition: A dedicated official-looking Instagram content account must be created and branded to direct viewers to Teyron's main account.
requirements.boundary_note: Username, profile image, bio, and main-account link are attributes of one account-setup task; secret credential contents are not Requirement evidence.

requirements.title: Approved Clip Publishing
requirements.definition: Client-approved clips must be published as Reels on the assigned Instagram account when posting authorization is given.
requirements.boundary_note: Owns the act of publishing approved clips; post metadata, timing, reporting, and account creation can evolve independently.

requirements.title: Instagram Post Metadata
requirements.definition: Each Reel must use the required promotional caption, hashtags, and in-post tag for Teyron's main account.
requirements.boundary_note: Caption, hashtag set, and account tag are attributes of one post-metadata mechanism; the unresolved main-account handle is a value ambiguity rather than a new Requirement.

requirements.title: Instagram Posting Schedule
requirements.definition: Approved clips must be spaced and posted according to the specified daily cadence and peak-hour window.
requirements.boundary_note: Posting time and one-per-day spacing can change independently of clip metadata and monthly creation volume.

requirements.title: Posting Tracking and Reporting
requirements.definition: After publishing, the freelancer must record the posting date and Reel link in the specified workspace and report the published link to the client.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers operational logging and link reporting after publication; audience-performance analytics are a separate tracking behavior.

requirements.title: Clip Performance Tracking
requirements.definition: Published clips must have views, engagement, and performance tracked transparently through the assigned account or supporting system.
requirements.boundary_note: Analytics tracking remains separate from recording the date and URL of a post; compensation calculations are administrative and excluded.

requirements.title: Lead Clipper Responsibilities
requirements.definition: The Lead Clipper role requires understanding brand standards deeply enough to approve other clippers' work, guide a pod, and keep the team operating to standard.
requirements.boundary_note: Treats team approval and management as one leadership role; training is supporting process rather than a separate Requirement, while changes between immediate assignment and future progression belong in its lifecycle.

requirements.title: Progress and Delay Communication
requirements.definition: The freelancer must respond reliably and communicate when delivery is behind schedule or additional time is needed.
requirements.boundary_note: This is independently actionable from clip delivery, but it is stated explicitly only in the termination rationale and should remain visible for later evidence review.
